input.description: Top 10 parks by distinct arriving guests, 19-21 Sep 2026
input.sql:
SELECT
    a.PARK_CODE,
    p.PARK_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.ARRIVAL_ID) AS arriving_guests
FROM NEXUS_BRONZE.DIG_ARRIVALS.ARRIVAL a
LEFT JOIN HAVEN_STORE.COMMON.DIM_PARK p
    ON a.PARK_CODE = p.PARK_CODE
WHERE a.ARRIVAL_DATE BETWEEN '2026-09-19' AND '2026-09-21'
  AND a.CANCELLED_AT IS NULL
  AND a.HVR_IS_DELETED = 0
GROUP BY a.PARK_CODE, p.PARK_NAME
ORDER BY arriving_guests DESC
LIMIT 10
